name: Handle arbitrary length encryption key from environment variable
description: Hash raw STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY to 32 bytes using SHA-256 in src/storage.ts to prevent crypto errors with arbitrary env key lengths.

inputs.task_prompt: In src/storage.ts, encryptData crashes when process.env.STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not exactly 32 bytes. Derive a guaranteed 32-byte key by passing the raw key through createHash('sha256').update(key).digest(). If STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY is unset, store plaintext without error. All tests in test/storage.test.ts must pass.

acceptance_criteria: Arbitrary length STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY is derived via sha256 to 32 bytes
When STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY is unset, plaintext fallback is used
